title: 033 width-relative label: NNNC models trained on a label relative to band width, used as a capital-neutral stake sizer on the width book (model exits off and on)
label: PROVISIONAL -- one era (2023-26). No outcome is recorded as a FINDING (constitution II / gate 2). A pass is PASS (PROVISIONAL) with a forward-confirmation route. Nothing is adopted or promoted.

setting.label: POOLED_LABEL (NNNC/_width_relative.py): gbb_path trade outcome (+2% target / -5% stop / 48-bar close) on entry-eligible bars (guard_metric<0.3, bb_width>0.035), top half of each of 10 bb_width deciles = BUY; gbb_path_sell outcome (2% fall / 2.2% take-profit / 48-bar close) on exit-eligible bars (guard_metric>0.3, bb_width>0.035), bottom half of each decile = SELL; deciles and cuts fitted on the training rows only; speed tie-break; min_bucket 500
setting.training_rows: %wr_keep: entry- or exit-eligible bars with a valid outcome, train and validation
setting.sizer: width book entries (NNNC_W_<M> cuts); stake = proposed x (1.0 agree | 0.5 disagree) / 0.75 (AGREE_SHARE 0.5): 1.333x / 0.667x
setting.threshold: research/width_relative/pick.py: 4-decimal threshold at the 0.5 quantile of the effective BUY probability over the first bar of each width-book candidate run in the fold's validation tail
setting.exit_on: same class, weights, thresholds and stakes; enable_exit_signal true; exit gate unchanged (rvol>2.0, guard_metric>-0.1)

label.on: training rows, each side, every fold

instrument.exit_off_trades_hash_equals_width_book: per fold; a differing fold is reported and FLAGGED, it does not fail S0 unless more than 2 of 15 folds differ
instrument.exit_on_liveness: every fold with exit-gate-passing bars inside open trades has >= 1 model exit

S1.rule: agree - disagree pp/trade gap of the width-relative model > the current model's on the identical width-book trades (simulator, co_sizing method)
S1.late_gap: not computed before S3; reported as context after S3 (separation.py --after-s3)

S2.exit_off: arm pp > width book pp AND arm pp > control pp
S2.exit_on: arm pp > exit-off arm pp AND arm pp > width book pp

S3.exit_off: judge_one(arm, control) PASS AND late pp > width book late pp
S3.exit_on: judge_one(exit-on, exit-off) PASS AND late pp > width book late pp

per_arm: each arm is judged independently; an S1 failure stops the exit-off arm only; an arm's records stay readable as the other arm's comparator
small_margin_rule: a stage passing by < 1 pp is INCONCLUSIVE until a paired seed-2 repeat (T025a)
